meta.name: Shadow 720p
meta.description:
Haunted by a tragic loss, an ex-cop with a rare inability to feel pain strikes out on his own to catch offenders who've eluded Johannesburg police.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Mary's Blackmail
videos.overview: As a rough-hewn cop-turned-vigilante, Shadow defends a client against a murderous, blackmailing mobster.

videos.title: Snow Globe Killer
videos.overview: A dancer approaches Shadow for help warding off a stalker: a disturbed man who makes snow globes containing figurines of the young women he targets.

videos.title: Ashley's Secret
videos.overview: Zola tells Ashley about the accident that led to her spinal injury. Shadow and Max intervene when Ashley runs afoul of a sinister businessman.

videos.title: Man Down
videos.overview: Shadow and Max track down an adversary from the past who's out on parole and set on revenge -- but they walk into a trap.

videos.title: Ghost Killer
videos.overview: When a vengeful rooftop shooter wreaks havoc on the city, Shadow and Max enlist Ashley's help to pin him down.

videos.title: Dare to Die
videos.overview: When his cash-needy friend gets involved in an online game that pays players to do dangerous stunts, Shadow joins the game to track down its mastermind.

videos.title: There's Something in the House
videos.overview: Scully agrees to help find Cyrus. Shadow's cousin Faith is spooked by strange activity around her house -- but there's more to it than meets the eye.

videos.title: The Reckoning
videos.overview: As Zola prepares for her treatment, Shadow takes off for Botswana to settle scores with Cyrus in a dangerous confrontation.
